Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Les Misérables", "unit": 317, "heading": "XVIII LE VAUTOUR DEVENU PROIE", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr81-u317-r0030", "target": "— Два топора и тесак.", "source_sha256": "d1be74f13c0c5333e9b8fe5e1c3de89150572072aa8777c815b0ad0d13e7e493", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u317-r0030", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "f5cb66696c83dfcc1f24cfd5362c8345620361fa8f1440c4dcd18ce7779949e7"}, {"source_id": "fr81-u317-r0031", "target": "— Хорошо. Нас двадцать шесть бойцов на ногах. Сколько ружей?", "source_sha256": "ff87209d6e48a0801976a0a520a8c69d954a1c0f6cb38a149b8b1efcf3cf030b", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u317-r0031", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "0172def12df7550cd505738c4ab0a8dc9927b31ff644bf0d04abb2cef9b747be"}], "source_language": "French", "part": 5, "book": 1, "chapter": 18, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr81-u317-r0032", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Trente-quatre.", "sha256": "9ab4e7c5b9782eb2ff74f7644492698e431321f0b9013aad981e5b0586536ab8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0033", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Huit de trop. Tenez ces fusils chargés comme les autres et sous la main. Aux ceintures les sabres et les pistolets. Vingt hommes à la barricade. Six embusqués aux mansardes et à la fenêtre du premier pour faire feu sur les assaillants à travers les meurtrières des pavés. Qu’il ne reste pas ici un seul travailleur inutile. Tout à l’heure, quand le tambour battra la charge, que les vingt d’en bas se précipitent à la barricade. Les premiers arrivés seront les mieux placés.", "sha256": "5cb47f512398a42e2d1b14a1c07206009a90ad94ac7b7d214565744da580826f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0034", "tag": "prose", "text": "Ces dispositions faites, il se tourna vers Javert, et lui dit :", "sha256": "828a5f3136c5aa620b1cd1985209387509dd9343fb591b63dbebd1b9135f6407", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0035", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je ne t’oublie pas.", "sha256": "9a57199a46b802e882c7c898605c40f04d531ba5b75fcb0f99d9fbb25355fb9d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0036", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et, posant sur la table un pistolet, il ajouta :", "sha256": "37441e6510e9f0e8675507f034d2ac7703b7b5a8d731dd20712c8a8a5eed570c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0037", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Le dernier qui sortira d’ici cassera la tête à cet espion.", "sha256": "47ebe9e301bf113470487b5f0733cace7871471b59264bcbe64ce1308aca85e6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0038", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ici ? demanda une voix.", "sha256": "ae8ebe48344f5617048a26dd5af8464f4ccc0a561ec90eff900ece39c55a30ea", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0039", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Non, ne mêlons pas ce cadavre aux nôtres. On peut enjamber la petite barricade sur la ruelle Mondétour. Elle n’a que quatre pieds de haut. L’homme est bien garrotté. On l’y mènera, et on l’y exécutera.", "sha256": "d7985ab09de7af64307f0af95be5a87b1942e2db4e4910982d40bebaf1036fbd", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0040", "tag": "prose", "text": "Quelqu’un, en ce moment-là, était plus impassible qu’Enjolras ; c’était Javert.", "sha256": "f2b88a657fb0d76c875839c9ed88b27d48ada67b8b968c9c96339e9f58e6037b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0041", "tag": "prose", "text": "Ici Jean Valjean apparut.", "sha256": "cdd1a5ab22c0c635d8f5bde719d79a715dbbf10d4a036ec128ae7d4825498322", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0042", "tag": "prose", "text": "Il était confondu dans le groupe des insurgés. Il en sortit, et dit à Enjolras :", "sha256": "8e0c80d02edf72389c42f2cf9941a1e35f2e3847e4ed2d9bf0b9d1be06fa4dce", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0043", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vous êtes le commandant ?", "sha256": "b988a75941d1518bcb71812f4acf37e53fb566edd07a0c99d8d7b6b2f5029a9c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0044", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oui.", "sha256": "9f4a2e0ce3c8b67038a54bfa044334c55d6f083e8cb634d6147afc7307b16a6f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0045", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vous m’avez remercié tout à l’heure.", "sha256": "a9dac0d171bae26573c726b41bc36d2986b39d99fdf89a894a0e72d3b3ba3ce2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0046", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Au nom de la République. La barricade a deux sauveurs, Marius Pontmercy et vous.", "sha256": "7a609894593cfe825fe80611cfa88df1a6aea4532c453da5988dd58a3ef1d580", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0047", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Pensez-vous que je mérite une récompense ?", "sha256": "896fbf1aadbbf19b69fdc9d316dff6d445492156b4742d34d74303607da389da", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0048", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Certes.", "sha256": "328b358973bb226e7bdbb21bd8f264248ecdc81a9635ac94afde5ff00b44a54e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0049", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Eh bien, j’en demande une.", "sha256": "9b59b6900d541568e258950acdb2fd32e585ac4b1231caa2d0c04a06f32bd821", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0050", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Laquelle ?", "sha256": "b525d13e33f59a8a16f4a50e4b4016a1da8f9d09844c7db906624a9dac57d4f3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0051", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Brûler moi-même la cervelle à cet homme-là.", "sha256": "095fee857c63220d2a272e8382167b8fe8cb900026cdd9bb358464fd2a26f823", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0052", "tag": "prose", "text": "Javert leva la tête, vit Jean Valjean, eut un mouvement imperceptible, et dit :", "sha256": "9d6d59438ab139ba2b1b11bd974ef995f20ba62449567c4d9305b44a284f39d3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0053", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est juste.", "sha256": "290d2b572cb3ceffbefa726fb82d094dfd8a1cbe073d069e14d5a29c0c37c1fa", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0054", "tag": "prose", "text": "Quant à Enjolras, il s’était mis à recharger sa carabine ; il promena ses yeux autour de lui :", "sha256": "0cbd1cd6f919afc82ef1bcd7ecd420f8c36394687b604871169766476318bc77", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0055", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Pas de réclamations ?", "sha256": "c50de887c1b6385c64a5ebc746abb2e7259b15aeb21d0db068c364fe5ad5e589", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0056", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et il se tourna vers Jean Valjean :", "sha256": "9ccc53f580e61b055e0c2ddae3e6775a83e53e0d7ad57a98381ac742d5295a06", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0057", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Prenez le mouchard.", "sha256": "49493e2105376d4e77dd6408cf494eb51a8913e5e23ce4a7e52ef0c7df407c3e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0058", "tag": "prose", "text": "Jean Valjean, en effet, prit possession de Javert en s’asseyant sur l’extrémité de la table. Il saisit le pistolet, et un faible cliquetis annonça qu’il venait de l’armer.", "sha256": "9d226c735cfa794bd50e634785a230e389642b230edda6b50c487a8877e8eb7f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0059", "tag": "prose", "text": "Presque au même instant, on entendit une sonnerie de clairons.", "sha256": "d79a144a96673e3fea5ebf61ab9c0d93a7a21b61938960d56ec30d09ecfd0d2d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0060", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Alerte ! cria Marius du haut de la barricade.", "sha256": "6b2b867f4defcaefb3c34e427e8744604e9f46121ee528ed87395951358e870b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0061", "tag": "prose", "text": "Javert se mit à rire de ce rire sans bruit qui lui était propre, et, regardant fixement les insurgés, leur dit :", "sha256": "fae0a49d1717c201e44d5d0aa8f77d242847906e014abc890177b3c1cd430d46", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0062", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vous n’êtes guère mieux portants que moi.", "sha256": "4b5878db278e6c7ad51f6d350a5a18bcbe9d3e409138ce3c77d226505cd2ead9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u317-r0063", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Tous dehors ! cria Enjolras.", "sha256": "e22d09a54e5b0ee8ba41287e5dc603184858a7bfb6178da974c609b5100ac5b7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
